svg.title: TACITUS / PRAXIS — from contested evidence to reviewable judgment
svg.desc: An illustrative dense knowledge graph links sources, actors, claims, commitments, events, methods and alternatives to reviewed context. Nine architecture layers distinguish evidence, claims, situation, time, ontology, reasoning, memory, governance and runtime. A fictional Nordalia example ends in a caveated conclusion, a verification question and a proposed next step. This is a conceptual architecture map, not a live product screenshot.
svg.text: From contested evidence to reviewable judgment.
Sources, ideas, relationships and analytical methods — connected, with uncertainty kept visible.
Suspension and willingness to talk coexist.
An allegation and a denial remain distinct.
Link next steps to evidence and review.
Conceptual architecture · fictional Nordalia scenario · not live telemetry
